parameters.content:
## Score Sales Navigator leads by ICP and draft outreach with Periodix Actions, Claude, Notion and Sheets

Queue LinkedIn or Sales Navigator search URLs in Notion. Every hour this workflow pulls each pending search with the Periodix Actions node, scores every lead against your ICP with Claude, writes a connection note and first message for qualified leads, and logs everything to Google Sheets. Rejected leads keep their score and reason so you can refine your ICP.

### How it works
1. Reads Notion rows with Status = Pending.
2. Periodix Actions runs each LinkedIn or Sales Navigator search URL.
3. Profiles are cleaned and deduped.
4. Claude scores each lead 1 to 10 against your ICP.
5. Leads scoring 5 or higher get a connection note and M1 message and go to the Validated tab. The rest go to Rejected with the reason.
6. The Notion row is marked Done.

### Setup
1. Install the verified Periodix Actions node (works on n8n Cloud and self-hosted), sign up at actions.periodix.net, connect a LinkedIn profile, and pick it in Search by URL.
2. Notion database with properties: Sales Nav URL (URL), Status (select: Pending, Done), Campaign (text), Processed At (date).
3. Google Sheet with Validated and Rejected tabs and columns: First Name, Last Name, Title, Company, Location, Industry, LinkedIn URL, Score, Reason, Connection Note, M1 Message, Campaign, Date, Notion Page ID.
4. Add your Anthropic credential to both Claude nodes and replace the product and ICP placeholders in both prompts.

Built on the infrastructure behind Periodix (rated 4.9/5 on G2): 0 LinkedIn accounts lost across 25,000 connected profiles in the last 24 months. From $10/month per profile with 1,000 results included, or $49/month unlimited.

### 1. Trigger & data source
Every hour, pulls pending search URLs from your Notion database (Status = Pending).

### 2. LinkedIn search & clean
Periodix Actions runs each LinkedIn or Sales Navigator search URL. Profiles are cleaned and deduped before any AI call.

### 3. AI ICP scoring
Claude scores each lead 1 to 10 against your ICP. Threshold: 5 or higher.

### 4. Messages & output
Qualified leads get a connection note and M1 message and go to the Validated tab. The rest go to Rejected with score and reason.

### 5. Status update
Marks the Notion row as Done after all leads from that search are processed.
⚠️ **Customize both Claude prompts**: replace the product context and ICP placeholders, and add your Anthropic credential to both Claude nodes.
